cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Seventh concept, and the first built off a DIRECT COMPETITOR rather than a lateral brand. GLP-1 SOS Supplements, FB 1281157230870004, 136 days running, same category and same avatar. Format ported one-to-one in Motilli's colours: off-white upper two thirds, vivid lime diagonal across the lower third, elegant serif headline with italic sub-line, a left column of ingredient rows each with a cutout photo and an arrow benefit, jar large on the right standing on the lime, scalloped seal top right, one white serif line along the bottom band. Micro-angle: relief that arrives on schedule, no cramping, no dash to the bathroom. Three headline pairs, identical layout. 4:5 at 1080x1350, all three cleared on the first roll.

cards.title: OURS · three headline pairs, one layout  ·  ours

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THE INGREDIENT COLUMN
cards.text:
The reference runs six rows. We have three actives, so the sixth-row padding would have to be invented. Four rows, and the fourth does a different job:

CELERY JUICE → Standardized, not a trace
APIGENIN → Stays in the colon
SOLUBLE FIBER → Feeds what regrows
NOT A LAXATIVE → Nothing gets forced

Row four is the differentiator dressed as an ingredient row. In a format built to be scanned against a competitor's label, the ABSENCE of a stimulant is the specification that matters most, and it lands harder in the column than it ever would in body copy.

Every benefit line traces to the mechanism bible. 'Standardized, not a trace' is the bible's own phrasing. 'Stays in the colon' is the apigenin poor-absorption point. 'Feeds what regrows' is the rebuild-then-feed order.

cards.title: WHAT WE DID NOT COPY · competitor discipline
cards.text:
This is a direct competitor, so the line between porting a format and lifting their work matters more here than anywhere else in the set.

THEIR HEADLINE IS THEIRS. 'Relief Like Clockwork' is a good line and it stays with them. All three of ours are written fresh in that register. Brooks asked for the angle, not the words.

THEIR SEAL reads TRUSTED BY 27,000+ with three stars. We have no verified customer count and inventing one breaks Law 2. Ours reads THIRD-PARTY TESTED, which is canon and is a stronger trust signal in this category anyway. No stars, because stars imply a rating we cannot source.

THEIR INGREDIENT BENEFITS are their formula: magnesium, ginger, peppermint, B12, probiotics, Bioperine. None of that is in our bottle and none of it appears in ours.

THEIR CLOSE is 'Clinically formulated for GLP-1 users.' Ours is 'Made for the GLP-1 gut', which claims the audience without claiming a clinical formulation process we have not documented.

CLEAN-ROOM: the competitor's bottle was never passed as a reference image. Our jar is the only product input.

cards.title: COLOUR TRANSLATION
cards.text:
The reference pairs cream with deep forest green and sets cream type on the green. Motilli's own pairing is bright lime with white, which is the same relationship one step brighter.

So: soft off-white above, vivid Motilli lime on the diagonal below, white serif on the lime. The headline stays a deep forest green so it holds contrast on the off-white and ties back to the darker end of the brand's range. The seal is deep green for the same reason.

cards.title: PRIMARY TEXT · all three
cards.text:
Nobody wants a bathroom emergency. They want to stop thinking about it.

On a GLP-1 the problem is not that nothing works, it is that the things that do work all work by force. A laxative makes one movement happen and rebuilds nothing, so tomorrow you are back where you started, usually at a higher dose. A tub of coarse fiber adds bulk to a colon that is already not moving it.

Here is what is actually going on. Your colon is a muscle, and it contracts on a signal called butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid the bacteria in your colon make out of the fiber that reaches them. A GLP-1 slows digestion down, which is the point, but the slowdown reaches all the way down there. Less material arrives, the colony thins out, butyrate falls, and the muscle stops being told to move.

Motilli is built to restore that signal rather than override it. Concentrated celery juice standardized for a real dose of apigenin, which barely absorbs into your bloodstream and so stays down in the colon where the problem is. Plus a fine soluble prebiotic fiber that feeds the butyrate makers without the coarse bulk that leaves you more distended than when you started.

Because nothing is being forced, there is no cramping and no urgency. The first few days are quiet. It fills in over the following weeks and rewards consistency rather than a single dose.

None of it touches your weight loss. Weight loss lives in the brain and the appetite. This lives in the colon. Two separate systems, so you rebuild one and stay on the other.

Two gummies before bed with a full glass of water. Sixty in a bottle. Third-party tested, lab results posted.

Ninety days to decide. Email inside ninety days and every dollar comes back, no return required.

cards.title: PRODUCTION NOTE · the even crop
cards.text:
Generated 3:4 and cropped to 4:5 split evenly top and bottom. That is the split that CLIPPED the gut-reset ad, and it worked here for one reason: the prompt asked for a clear empty margin at the top AND a clear band of green below the bottom line.

Instruct both ends and an even crop is safe. Instruct neither and the model stacks content upward, which is what caused the earlier clip.

Rule of thumb: name the margin at whichever end carries text, then crop from wherever the prompt guaranteed space.

cards.title: FRAME QA · all three
cards.text:
Headline pair: PASS. Serif headline plus italic sub-line, spelled exactly, inset from both edges, nothing clipped.

Ingredient column: PASS. Exactly four rows in all three, correct thumbnail, name and benefit on each, dashed connector running down through them. No fifth row.

Seal: PASS. Scalloped circle, THIRD-PARTY TESTED, no stars, no review count in any frame.

Jar: PASS. One jar, large, standing on the lime diagonal, motilli wordmark and CELERY JUICE FIBER GUMMIES legible.

Bottom band: PASS. 'Made for the GLP-1 gut' in white serif, GLP-1 hyphenated correctly, clear of the bottom edge.

Background: PASS. Clean off-white above, no yellow or golden cast. Vivid lime diagonal below.

No invented badges, prices, star ratings, review counts or percentages.

cards.title: AUDIT
cards.text:
Law 2: no invented study, percentage, doctor, review count or customer quote. The competitor's 27,000+ figure was dropped rather than matched.

Law 6: competitor intelligence stayed a brief direction. No line of their copy appears in ours, no comparison is drawn, and they are not named or alluded to on the creative.

Law 9: no em dashes, no negation-affirmation beats, no parallel stacks, no rhetorical openers.

Two separate systems: present.

Swap test: PASS, and this is the strongest pass in the set. Drop their capsule into this ad and row four breaks it, because a magnesium formula is stimulant-adjacent and cannot claim nothing gets forced.

Shelf life: evergreen.

CLAIM RISK: low. No body imagery, no before and after, no numeric timeline anywhere on the creative.

VERIFY BEFORE LAUNCH: the 90-day no-return-required guarantee wording against the live policy page, AND confirm third-party testing documentation is actually posted before the seal runs.

cards.title: THE SEVEN CONCEPTS
cards.text:
MOT-PREG-MIRROR-01 · fogged-mirror statics. Qualifies her.
MOT-PREG-TIMELINE-01 · illustrated de-bloat timeline. Shows how long it takes.
MOT-MECHANISM-3D-01 · 9 ads, 3D organs week by week. Shows why it happens.
MOT-XRAY-CELERY-01 · 3 ads, X-ray before and after. Proves it. STILL ON 5 DAYS, Brooks's call whether to move it to weeks.
MOT-GUTRESET-01 · 3 ads, ingredient grid. Collapses the effort objection.
MOT-CLAY-WAKEUP-01 · 3 ads, clay diorama. The mechanism as a handmade object.
MOT-CLOCKWORK-01 · 3 ads, this one. The spec sheet, aimed at the comparison shopper.
